purpose: HMRC Capital Gains Tax statistics 2026 release rows the CGT asset-type stage assigns from and reports against: Table 8a tax year 2024-25 UK residents reporting residential property disposals (taxpayers, disposals, gains and tax by reporting channel: the CGT on UK Property service, the Self Assessment component and their total), Table 8b tax year 2024-25 UK Property service returns by taxpayer type (individuals, trusts and all; the individuals/all shares that restate Table 8a on the individuals basis of the national targets), Table 4.1 tax year 2024-25 Business Asset Disposal Relief and Investors' Relief claimants, qualifying gains and tax (individuals by band of qualifying gain with their total, and the trusts and all-taxpayer totals; the band targets the BADR draw solves, microcosm#1014) and Table 7 tax year 2023-24 disposals, disposal proceeds and gains by asset category and asset type (sample-based; the composition prior for the non-residential asset-type draw, fenced from calibration). No value is derived here.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
